newsitem.title: USA: AAR files for two million share offering.
newsitem.headline: AAR files for two million share offering.

text.p: AAR Corp, which supplies aerospace/aviation products and services, said on Tuesday it is registering with the Securities and Exchange Commission a proposed public offering of two million of its common shares.
The total excludes a 15 percent overallotment option granted to underwriters. All of the shares are being offered by the company.

AAR said proceeds from the offering will be used for general corporate purposes, which include expansion of the company's trading, overhaul and manufacturing activities, either by internal growth or through acquisition.
Underwriters are led by Goldman, Sachs & Co and William Blair & Co.
Shares of AAR closed at 28-1/2 yesterday.
